title: Innovation & Tech
completion_message: ¡Brillante! Ahora dominas la jerga de Silicon Valley. Palabras como 'disruptive', 'paradigm shift' o 'scalable' te permitirán liderar conversaciones sobre innovación, transformación digital y startups.

parts.visual:
Transformación y Mercado: 
- Disruptive (Disruptivo / Que rompe el mercado tradicional con una nueva tecnología o modelo). 
Ej: Uber was a disruptive force in the taxi industry. 
- Paradigm shift (Cambio de paradigma / Un cambio fundamental en cómo se hacen las cosas). 
Ej: AI is causing a paradigm shift in software development. 
- Scalable (Escalable / Un negocio o sistema que puede crecer enormemente sin que sus costos aumenten al mismo ritmo). 
Ej: Software is highly scalable; consulting is not.
parts.audio: Transformation and Market. 'Disruptive' describes something that completely changes the traditional market with a new technology or model. For example: Uber was a disruptive force in the taxi industry. A 'Paradigm shift' is a fundamental change in approach or underlying assumptions. For example: A I is causing a paradigm shift in software development. 'Scalable' describes a business or system that can grow enormously without its costs increasing at the same rate. For example: Software is highly scalable; consulting is not.

parts.visual:
Tecnología Avanzada y Métodos: 
- Bleeding-edge (Tecnología de vanguardia absoluta, tan nueva que a veces tiene riesgos o fallas). 
Ej: We use bleeding-edge technology, which is sometimes unstable. 
- Outdated / Obsolete (Obsoleto / Que ya no sirve o está anticuado). 
Ej: That software is completely obsolete now. 
- Pain point (Punto de dolor / El problema específico que un cliente tiene y que tu producto resuelve). 
Ej: Our app solves the main pain point for remote workers.
parts.audio: Advanced Technology and Methods. 'Bleeding-edge' refers to technology that is so new that it may have a high risk of being unreliable. For example: We use bleeding-edge technology, which is sometimes unstable. 'Obsolete' or 'Outdated' means something is no longer produced or used; it's out of date. For example: That software is completely obsolete now. A 'Pain point' is a specific problem that a customer has, which your product aims to solve. For example: Our app solves the main pain point for remote workers.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el término de innovación o tecnología correcto.

questions.question: Smartphones were a ____ technology that completely destroyed the digital camera market. (Disruptivo / Que rompe el mercado).
questions.explanation: Disruptive = disruptivo (que cambia las reglas de una industria).

questions.question: Moving from physical stores to e-commerce was a huge ____ shift for the retail industry. (Cambio de paradigma).
questions.explanation: Paradigm shift = cambio de paradigma / cambio fundamental.

questions.question: Investors love software companies because their business model is highly ____. You build it once and sell it millions of times. (Escalable).
questions.explanation: Scalable = escalable (capacidad de crecer masivamente con bajos costos marginales).

questions.question: This technology isn't just cutting-edge; it is ____-edge. It's so new that it still has bugs. (De vanguardia absoluta / Innovación extrema).
questions.explanation: Bleeding-edge = más nuevo que cutting-edge, tan innovador que conlleva riesgos.

questions.question: Floppy disks and CD-ROMs are completely ____ today. Nobody uses them. (Obsoletos).
Our marketing team needs to identify the customer's main ____ point so we can solve it. (Punto de dolor / Problema).
questions.explanation: Pain point = el problema o frustración principal del cliente.

questions.question: We work using an ____ methodology, which allows us to adapt to changes quickly in two-week sprints. (Ágil).
questions.explanation: Agile methodology = metodología ágil (scrum, kanban, etc.).

questions.question: Instead of building the full app, let's launch an MVP. What does MVP stand for? (Producto Mínimo Viable).
questions.explanation: Minimum Viable Product (MVP) = el producto con las funciones mínimas para salir al mercado.

questions.question: The process of moving all our local servers to the internet is called ____ migration. (Migración a la nube).
questions.explanation: Cloud migration = migración a la nube.

questions.question: To stay competitive, we need to completely ____ our supply chain using AI. (Modernizar / Reformar por completo).
questions.explanation: Overhaul = revisar y modernizar/reparar por completo un sistema.

questions.question: The software is designed to ____ repetitive tasks, so humans don't have to do them. (Automatizar).
The app is very ____-friendly. Even my grandmother can use it easily. (Fácil de usar para el usuario).
Our system has a ____ that prevents hackers from stealing data. (Cortafuegos / Sistema de seguridad).
Before launching, we need to fix a few minor ____ in the code. (Errores / Fallos).
questions.explanation: Bugs = errores en el código de software.

questions.question: The CEO wants to ____ AI across all departments by next year. (Implementar / Desplegar).
questions.explanation: Deploy = implementar, desplegar, poner en funcionamiento.

questions.question: It's an ____-source project, meaning anyone can see and modify the code for free. (De código abierto).
We use strong ____ to make sure no one can intercept our messages. (Encriptación / Cifrado).
This new microchip is a massive ____ in computing power. (Avance tecnológico / Descubrimiento).
Because of the high web traffic, our servers experienced some ____ yesterday. (Tiempo de inactividad / Caída del sistema).
questions.explanation: Downtime = tiempo de inactividad o caída de un servidor/sistema.

questions.question: The startup aims to ____ the real estate market by eliminating brokers. (Alterar/Revolucionar una industria).
questions.explanation: Disrupt = alterar, revolucionar, romper el esquema tradicional de un mercado.
